sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Batya is a story chapter in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: "Turns out BEAR didn't send just regular squads into Tarkov, there were real SOF guys here. I'd like to know more about those units and what exactly they were doing."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text:
Visit one of the following locations:
- Mattress below the "жопа" writing on the second floor of the Scav base on Customs

- Radome on top of the white queen radar station building on Reserve

- Bunker north of the health resort on Shoreline

- Mattresses on top of the big rock at the USEC camp on Woods

sections.heading: Locate the traces of the BEAR special squad
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Bogatyrs patch | 1 | Required | Yes |
To fulfill this objective, you have to pick up and read the Bogatyrs patch from Customs, Woods, Reserve or Lighthouse.

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text: On a couch inside the cabin located on top of the hill southwest of the new gas station.

sections.heading: Woods
sections.text: On the ground next to the BRDM from the cargo convoy.

sections.heading: Reserve
sections.text: On a package on the upper roof of the airspace control center marked with white king.

sections.heading: Lighthouse
sections.text: On a sleeping bag in the BEAR camp.

sections.heading: Learn more about the Bogatyr squad from the traders
sections.text: Visit Jaeger in the menu through the trader screen and ask him about the BEAR patch.

sections.heading: Locate the Ryabina outpost
sections.text: The Ryabina outpost is located north of the sawmill on Woods.

sections.heading: Find more information about the Bogatyr squad
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Strelets' amulet | 1 | Required | Yes |
| Hostage evacuation report from Voevoda | 1 | Required | Yes |
To fulfill this objective, you have to pick up and read a note as well as pick up a quest item from the camp. Strelets' amulet should be transferred to the off-raid quest inventory to not lose it in subsequent raids. It will be needed later.

The Carousel outpost is located opposite the IDEA store checkout area inside the ULTRA shopping mall on Interchange. sections.heading: Locate the ambush spot
sections.text: The ambush spot, specifically Moreman's grave is located near the ZB-016 extraction in the east of Woods.

sections.heading: Retrieve more information about the ambush from Moreman's phone
sections.text:
| Related Quest Items |
| Icon | Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Moreman's audio tape 1 | Moreman's audio tape #1 | 1 | Required | N/A | Has to be crafted in the Hideout (Workbench lv. 1). |
| Moreman's audio tape 2 | Moreman's audio tape #2 | 1 | Required | N/A | Has to be crafted in the Hideout (Workbench lv. 1). |
Craft Moreman's audio tape #1 and Moreman's audio tape #2 at the Workbench level 1 in the Hideout and listen to them. Electricity is required during the entire process, otherwise it will be interrupted.

sections.heading: Obtain Intelligence Center level 3
sections.text: Upgrade the Intelligence Center to level 3 in the Hideout.

sections.heading: Contact the Bogatyr squad
sections.text: Contact Voevoda through the radio system at the Intelligence Center in the Hideout. First enter the frequency "35.70", as hinted at from the First piece of code note and Second piece of code note. Next enter the code "27.893.2000" as hinted at from Strelets' note.

sections.heading: Gain access to Lightkeeper
sections.text:
Lightkeeper can be found on the Lighthouse location. He is located in a locked area on the 3rd floor of the lighthouse building at the peninsula territory.

The bridge that leads to the lighthouse is guarded by Zryachiy and full of Claymores. To safely pass the bridge and speak to Lightkeeper, an encoded Digital secure DSP radio transmitter is required. It deactivates the claymores and has Zryachiy not shoot you. The questline to obtain one starts with the quest To the Light - Trust but Verify.

Harming Zryachiy, one of his followers, or a Lightkeeper acquainted PMC in the lighthouse premises will decode your Digital secure DSP radio transmitter if you have it equipped (Attention: Unequipping it does not prevent this in local PvE game mode raids). PMC's that are acquainted with Lightkeeper can kill unacquainted intruders without penalty.

sections.heading: Bring all the Bogatyr squad's items to Lightkeeper
sections.text:
| Related Quest Items |
| Icon | Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Taran's postcard | Taran's postcard | 1 | Handover item | Yes |
| Voevoda's audio recorder (quest item) | Voevoda's audio recorder | 1 | Handover item | Yes |
| Strelets' amulet | Strelets' amulet | 1 | Handover item | Yes |
| Moreman's dogtag | Moreman's dogtag | 1 | Handover item | Yes |
| Bogatyrs patch | Bogatyrs patch | 1 | Handover item | Yes |
Transfer Taran's postcard, Voevoda's audio recorder, Strelets' amulet, Moreman's dogtag and the Bogatyrs patch to the in-raid quest inventory and hand them over to Lightkeeper.

sections.heading: Wait for Voevoda to reach out
sections.text: Wait 6-12 hours for Voevoda to reach out, then contact him through the radio system at the Intelligence Center Hideout. Enter frequency "35.70" and the code "27.893.2000" again.

sections.heading: Complete Voevoda's tasks
sections.text:
- Reach the Light Machine Guns skill level 5
- Reach the Assault Rifles skill level 10
- Reach the Stress Resistance skill level 10
- Reach the Strength skill level 15
- Eliminate any 15 targets without dying
- Eliminate 4 PMC operatives without dying

sections.heading: Contact Voevoda
sections.text: Contact Voevoda through the radio system at the Intelligence Center in the Hideout. Enter frequency "35.70" and the code "27.893.2000" again.

sections.heading: Locate the traces of the traitors
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Note mentioning Prapor | 1 | Required | Yes |
The Note mentioning Prapor to pick up and read to fulfill this objective can be found at the BEAR camp on Lighthouse.

sections.heading: Interrogate Prapor
sections.text: Visit Prapor in the menu through the trader screen.

sections.heading: Figure out how the cultists are connected to the General
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Voevoda's photo with a cultist mark | 1 | Required | Yes |
| Note mentioning General | 1 | Required | Yes |
| Dorm room 314 marked key | 1 | Required* | N/A |
- Not all spawn locations for the quest item require this key. It is not entirely needed to complete the objective.

To fulfill this objective, you have to pick up and read 2 notes from Shoreline and either Woods or Customs.

sections.heading: Voevoda's photo with a cultist mark - Shoreline
sections.text: In the house on the island.

sections.heading: Woods
sections.text: At the marked circle in the woods west of the sawmill near the checkpoint.

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text: In the marked room on the third floor of the three-story dorms building. A Dorm room 314 marked key is required to enter it.

sections.heading: Talk to Lightkeeper
sections.text: Visit Lightkeeper on Lighthouse.

sections.heading: Wait for Lightkeeper to prepare the documents on The Unheard
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Agent network deployment report | 1 | Required | Yes |
In a new raid, return to Lightkeeper's area on Lighthouse and pick up and read the Agent network deployment report. The objective will be completed after 6 hours.
